title: Security Deposit Account Goodwill for Prompt Statement Disputes
content:
**Q. What does a prompt dispute earn on a Security Deposit Account repair credit?**
A. A prompt dispute earns dispute goodwill, which is added to the repair credit. The amount depends on when the latest dispute recorded against the statement was submitted, counted in calendar days after the statement date:

- **20.00 USD** when it was submitted no more than 7 calendar days after the statement date;
- **10.00 USD** when it was submitted more than 7 but no more than 14 calendar days after it;
- **none** when it was submitted later.

**Q. How does it enter the credit?**
A. The repair credit is the repair charged less the corrected repair charge, plus the dispute goodwill, rounded half up to the cent.

**Q. Which records are read?**
A. The submission date of the latest dispute recorded against the account's statement, and the statement date on the deposit account.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, statement dated 1 June)

| Latest dispute submitted | Days after the statement | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| 8 June | 7 | 20.00 USD |
| 9 June | 8 | 10.00 USD |
| 15 June | 14 | 10.00 USD |
| 16 June | 15 | none |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** The repair charged is 300.00 USD and the corrected repair charge is 255.00 USD. With a dispute submitted 5 days after the statement, the repair credit is 45.00 plus 20.00, which is 65.00 USD.
